name: antigravity
label: Google Antigravity (IDE / App / CLI)
description: Production-supported runtime adapter for AIKit in Google Antigravity (Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, agy CLI). Supports both global plugins (~/.gemini/config/plugins/) and workspace adapter installation (.agents/).

runtime_entrypoints.name: project-rules
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Project rules for Antigravity: the AIKit block (base + profile rules) is managed by the installer, user content outside it is kept.

runtime_entrypoints.name: antigravity-runtime-guide
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-specific AIKit instructions for Antigravity workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: antigravity-native-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: AIKit agents as Antigravity custom subagents (.agents/agents/*.md).

runtime_entrypoints.name: antigravity-native-skills
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: AIKit skills in the Agent Skills format (<name>/SKILL.md) that Antigravity discovers in the repository.

runtime_entrypoints.name: packaged-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: AIKit agents packaged for the Antigravity runtime.

notes: Supports global plugins in ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ and agy plugin install
Also supports workspace install flow through scripts/install-adapter-package.py antigravity
Uses native .agents/ customization directory for skills, agents, hooks and MCP
